def test_max_element():
    # Basic cases
    assert max_element([1, 2, 3]) == 3
    assert max_element([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, 124]) == 124
    assert max_element([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, -124]) == 9

    # Single element list
    assert max_element([7]) == 7
    assert max_element([-7]) == -7

    # All negative numbers
    assert max_element([-10, -20, -3, -50]) == -3

    # Duplicates of the maximum
    assert max_element([4, 4, 4]) == 4
    assert max_element([1, 5, 5, 2]) == 5

    # Max at various positions
    assert max_element([10, 1, 2, 3]) == 10   # max at start
    assert max_element([1, 2, 3, 10]) == 10   # max at end
    assert max_element([1, 10, 2, 3]) == 10   # max in middle

    # Floats
    assert max_element([1.5, 2.7, 0.3]) == 2.7

    # Two elements
    assert max_element([1, 2]) == 2
    assert max_element([2, 1]) == 2

    print("All tests passed!")

def test_max_element():
    # Basic positive numbers
    assert max_element([1, 2, 3]) == 3
    assert max_element([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, 124]) == 124

    # All negative numbers
    assert max_element([-1, -5, -3]) == -1
    assert max_element([-10, -20, -30]) == -10

    # Mixed positive and negative
    assert max_element([-5, 0, 5]) == 5
    assert max_element([0, -1, -2]) == 0

    # Single element
    assert max_element([42]) == 42
    assert max_element([-7]) == -7

    # Duplicates
    assert max_element([7, 7, 7]) == 7
    assert max_element([1, 3, 3, 2]) == 3

    # Max at various positions
    assert max_element([10, 1, 2, 3]) == 10   # max first
    assert max_element([1, 2, 3, 10]) == 10   # max last
    assert max_element([1, 10, 2, 3]) == 10   # max middle

    # Floats
    assert max_element([1.5, 2.7, 0.3]) == 2.7
    assert max_element([-1.5, -2.7, -0.3]) == -0.3

    # Large numbers
    assert max_element([10**9, 10**18]) == 10**18

    # Empty list should raise IndexError
    try:
        max_element([])
        assert False, "Expected IndexError for empty list"
    except IndexError:
        pass

    print("All tests passed!")
